scope: Static read-only review of observed-artifact verification and scoped correction feedback in the composed working tree

reviewedClaims.evidence: Verifier rehashes every successfully parsed artifact observation after the last executed profile, including after a negative later result; mutation/deletion invalidates the prior payload before persistence.
Adapter filters exactly the previous attempt, rejects more than one row, and validates task/mission/brief/scope/output SHA, previous fencing token, worker metadata, scopeVersion and canonical digest.

Diagnostic text is copied through a bounded schema and JSON-escaped for delimiters. Original task instructions and allowed paths stay unchanged. The JSON is explicitly untrusted and does not grant permissions.

Supervisor accepts only the exact previous output SHA in a clean expected branch, repeats Git and verifier checks, blocks unchanged output plus unchanged failure, and excludes capabilitySelection tasks from automatic correction feedback.

reviewedClaims.check: Policy assertions preserved after upstream composition
reviewedClaims.evidence: Both observation-policy uniqueness and before-role assertions remain, together with upstream Request normalization and discovery error envelope expectations.

limits: This is static review, not an additional test campaign or proof of deployment.
Final hashing is not an immutable filesystem snapshot or continuous surveillance.
An observer report does not independently prove the perceptual accuracy of its trusted observer.
Prompt boundary checks do not guarantee that every model will obey the instructions.
A missing checkpoint in an intervening generation intentionally prevents automatic recovery of older output.
